postTitle: When the Default Plan Doesn't Fit You
topic: Most of the protection a household needs is free; the common failure is not knowing the default exists

assumptions.notes: No figures. Three cost bands from the post: free (an evening), modest (a professional, e.g. a will or powers of attorney), hard (recognition gaps no document closes, handled with workarounds). The one hour audit has five lists.

bands.label: Hard
items: The right name from the start

hookVariants.narration: Most of the protection your household needs costs nothing. People skip it because they do not know it is missing.
One evening of paperwork does most of what a lawyer would.
The usual reason a household is unprotected is not cost. It is not knowing.

beats.narration: Fixes for a default that does not fit you come in three price bands.
Free, in an evening. Name beneficiaries on every pension and policy. Write down who owns what. List every account.
Modest, and worth doing properly. A will. Powers of attorney. A written agreement about what you own together.
And hard: gaps no document closes, like a marriage your country does not recognise. There, the tools are workarounds, like insurance and a bigger buffer.
beats.subtext: When no document closes the gap

beats.narration: Most of the protection sits in the first band. The usual failure is not cost. It is not knowing.
So spend one hour on five lists. Accounts that pay out. What you own jointly. Who inherits with no will. Who could act for you. What you would lose with your job.

rows.label: What you would lose with your job

caption.instagram:
Most of the protection your household needs costs nothing. People skip it because they do not know it is missing.

Fixes come in three bands. Free, in an evening: name beneficiaries on every pension and policy, write down who owns what, list every account where someone you trust can find it. Modest, worth doing properly: a will, powers of attorney, a written agreement about what you own together. Hard: gaps no document closes, handled with workarounds like insurance and a bigger buffer.

The one hour audit: every account that pays out, what you own jointly, who inherits with no will, who could act for you, and what you would lose with your job.
